intro.title: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
intro.description:
Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh 🌙

Welcome to Nida — Prayer Times for Home Assistant.

This integration uses the free AlAdhan API (aladhan.com) to provide accurate daily prayer times based on your location. We are truly grateful for this wonderful free service — may Allah reward those who built and maintain it.

Press Submit to continue.

location.title: Location & Calculation Method
location.description: Enter your city and country to fetch accurate prayer times.

reminders.title: Pre-Adhan Reminders
reminders.description: Play a sound and/or spoken message before each prayer time. Use {minutes} and {prayer} in your message.

fajr.title: Fajr Adhan
fajr.description: Configure the adhan specifically for Fajr prayer.

adhan.title: Adhan Settings
adhan.description: Configure the adhan for all daily prayers.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure push notifications per event type. Use {prayer} and {minutes} as placeholders in messages.

ramadan.title: Ramadan Settings
ramadan.description: Configure Suhoor alarm and Tarhim recitation. These only activate during Ramadan.
